exec sp_executesql N'SELECT TOP (2+18) ORDER_ID, ORDER_NUMBER, ORDER_DATE, VAT_RATE FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID BETWEEN @FROMID AND @TOID AND ORDER_DATE >= @FROMDATE AND VAT_RATE <= @MAXVAT AND (@FLAG = 1 OR VAT_RATE > 0) AND ORDER_ID <> @EXB AND ORDER_ID NOT IN (7,9) AND ORDER_ID > 6 ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC, ORDER_ID',N'@FROMID int,@TOID int,@FROMDATE datetime,@MAXVAT float,@FLAG bit,@EXB nvarchar(4000)',@FROMID=5,@TOID=60,@FROMDATE='2024-02-01 00:00:00',@MAXVAT=21.5,@FLAG=1,@EXB=N'40'

exec sp_executesql N'SELECT COMPANY_NAME, COUNTRY FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE COUNTRY = @COUNTRY AND COMPANY_NAME LIKE @PATTERN ORDER BY COMPANY_NAME',N'@COUNTRY nvarchar(6),@PATTERN nvarchar(2)',@COUNTRY=N'France',@PATTERN=N'L%'
